benchmark_name: Nexora OR-Tools CP-SAT Network Scheduling Benchmark

prototype_assumptions: Track block capacity = 1 (single-block section per consecutive station pair)
Safety headway = 60 seconds buffer between consecutive block occupancies
Travel times use historical observation medians where available; fallback to 45 km/h + 20s station dwell
Latest Random Forest prediction row per train selected deterministically from rf_optimization_inputs.csv
Model operates on logical edge occupancies and does NOT simulate physical signals, interlocking, or platforms

case_a_no_conflict.description: Two trains with disjoint temporal windows on same track
case_a_no_conflict.conclusion: Zero unnecessary hold applied when track ahead is clear

case_b_priority_ordering.description: Fast Express (Priority 2.0) and Slow Local (Priority 1.0) ready simultaneously
case_b_priority_ordering.conclusion: Fast Express dispatched first with 0s hold; Slow Local held by necessary headway buffer

case_c_delayed_train_clear_track.description: Delayed train (+25m) with clear track ahead
case_c_delayed_train_clear_track.conclusion: Delayed train dispatched immediately at earliest feasible time with 0s additional hold

case_d_cascading_delay_suppression.description: Primary delay disruption with trailing follower trains
case_d_cascading_delay_suppression.conclusion: Hold applied only to minimum extent necessary to prevent cascading headway violations

findings: 19.55 minutes is proven to be the mathematical minimum feasible total optimizer hold under the current prototype assumptions.
Nexora reduces maximum individual train delay from 46.5 min down to 40.58 min (a 12.7% reduction in worst-case delay).
Nexora reduces delay variance from 138.2 min^2 down to 115.4 min^2 (a 16.5% improvement in schedule fairness/predictability).
Total completion delay is identical between FIFO and Nexora (273.78 min) because all 10 trains share a single bottleneck trunk track in the same direction.

final_verdict: NEXORA OBJECTIVE VERIFIED — IMPROVES DELAY DISTRIBUTION BUT NOT TOTAL DELAY
